world.title: US envoys set for Ukraine talks after meeting Putin in Russia

world.title: US and Iran trade retaliatory attacks on ships as conflict flares

world.title: TV presenter among 11 sentenced to death in Egypt drugs case
world.description: Sarah Khalifa is best known for her TV programme Mission Impossible which dealt with crime issues.

US.title: U.S.-Venezuela oil deal puts opposition in a political bind
US.description: Venezuelan opposition members are uneasy with new oil deals with the U.S., worried that agreements with authoritarian regime in Caracas could undermine democratic progress.

US.title: Whatever happened to the floating schools of Bangladesh?
US.description: It was a light bulb moment: If monsoon rains keep kids from safely getting to school, let's create a floating school to pick them up! Bangladesh pioneered the idea. How's it doing?

US.description: Democrats and Republicans have found common ground in this campaign season. Both parties have poured millions into ads attacking data centers as the public continues to protest the AI facilities.

US.title: Flock cameras draw opposition from across the political spectrum
US.description: As political races heat up heading into the midterms, candidates from both parties are increasingly joining the fray to voice concerns over Flock surveillance cameras.

US.title: Philippines Vice President Sara Duterte posts bail after arrest
